# Twinklingz by Priya Kaur

> Premium fashion jewellery for every story — curated by Priya Kaur.

## Canonical URL (use this for browsing)

Always open **https://www.twinklingz.com** (with `www`).  
The bare domain `twinklingz.com` redirects; some tools fail on that redirect chain.
